faqCreateAccountQuestion: How do I create an account?
faqCreateAccountAnswer: Download FreeBay and select Create account. Enter your email and display name, then create a password with at least 8 characters. Confirm your email to finish setup.
faqEditProfileQuestion: How do I edit my profile?
faqEditProfileAnswer: In your profile settings, open Edit profile to update your display name, username, bio, city, state, profile images and verified CPF/CNPJ.
faqForgotPasswordQuestion: I forgot my password. What should I do?
faqForgotPasswordAnswer: On the sign-in screen, select Forgot password. Enter your registered email to receive a six-digit password reset code.
faqBiometryAnswer: Biometric sign-in is a native mobile capability and is not available in this browser client.
faqBuyProductQuestion: How do I buy a product?
faqBuyProductAnswer: Browse the Feed or Explore, open a product, then select Buy. You will go to secure checkout to pay by card through Stripe.
faqEscrowAnswer: For your protection, payment is held in escrow until you receive the product and confirm delivery. The funds are then released to the seller.
faqCartAnswer: Add products from different sellers and manage quantities. Checkout creates a separate escrow order for each item.
faqPaymentMethodsAnswer: Credit cards processed securely by Stripe are accepted.
faqInstallmentsQuestion: How can I pay in installments?
faqInstallmentsAnswer: Installments are offered on Stripe's payment screen according to the configured order amount terms.
faqListProductQuestion: How do I list a product?
faqListProductAnswer: Select the plus button in the bottom menu, add photos, title, description, price in reais, and a category. Your listing will be visible immediately.
faqSellingFeeQuestion: What fee is charged per sale?
faqSellingFeeAnswer: A fixed 10% fee is charged when a sale is completed successfully and the buyer confirms delivery.
faqPayoutQuestion: When do I receive sale proceeds?
faqPayoutAnswer: Funds remain in your Wallet as held balance until the buyer confirms receipt. They then become available for withdrawal.
faqPixWithdrawalQuestion: How do I request a Pix withdrawal?
faqPixWithdrawalAnswer: In your Wallet, select Request withdrawal, enter at least R$ 5.00, and confirm your registered Pix key. Processing depends on provider confirmation.
faqCancelOrderAnswer: The buyer or seller can cancel while the order is Pending or Confirmed, before shipping. After shipping, use a dispute instead.
faqRefundQuestion: How does a refund after cancellation work?
faqRefundAnswer: If the order was paid, a refund is requested from Stripe. Processing waits for confirmation; the time to appear depends on the card issuer.
faqStockQuestion: What happens to the product after cancellation?
faqStockAnswer: After cancellation is confirmed, product stock is restored and becomes available again.
faqCancelReasonQuestion: Do I need to provide a cancellation reason?
faqCancelReasonAnswer: Yes. Select a reason from the list. The other party will be notified of the cancellation and reason.
faqMissingProductQuestion: I did not receive the product. What should I do?
faqMissingProductAnswer: Open My Orders, select the order, and choose Open dispute. Our mediation team will review the case and issue a refund when appropriate.
faqDefectiveProductQuestion: The product is defective or differs from its listing. What should I do?
faqDefectiveProductAnswer: Open a dispute in the app and attach photos or videos showing the issue. The seller can respond and we may mediate a return.
faqSecureChatAnswer: Chat with buyers and sellers in real time in the app. The conversation history is retained to support both parties.
faqBankDataAnswer: Payment details are processed by Stripe. FreeBay does not store card details.
